acquisition.availability_preflight: all exact URLs were streamed through strict PDF parsing and bounded identity/orderable-package text checks on 2026-09-17; bodies were immediately deleted and no hash, render, region, annotation, query, or score was retained. Cycle v4 remains frozen; MMA8451Q was not replaced in that plan.
acquisition.post_seal_artifact: dsvire.retrieval-cycle-source-manifest.v1 with final URL, bytes, and SHA-256

annotation.review_protocol: two-pass blinded review; author and independent human adjudicator cannot inspect model scores
annotation.agent_audit_policy: agent audit may reject unsafe crops before independent review but cannot satisfy independent-review acceptance
annotation.disagreements: adjudicate before query encoding; unresolved regions are excluded and recorded

queries.authoring: manual natural-language prompts written after region adjudication and before model scoring
queries.review_protocol: independent human reviewer checks intent, exact identity, relevance, and hard-negative links without model scores
prohibited: labels or case IDs in query text

candidate_universe.crop_ranking: every adjudicated region in the selected split for every query
candidate_universe.full_page_baseline: every rendered page in the selected split for every query
candidate_universe.unannotated_figures: not silently counted as negatives; record judgment incompleteness separately

systems.candidate: pinned ColSmol crop BM25+dense/RRF+MaxSim cascade plus a separately calibrated EGVV decision layer
comparators: same pinned ColSmol over naive full pages
unscoped BM25 text-RAG over crop text

execution_order: acquire and hash official sources into a separate immutable manifest
annotate calibration and evaluation without model scores
obtain independent review and seal annotations before score access
author and independently review queries without model scores
run calibration systems and freeze the candidate and EGVV policy
publish passing or failing compact evidence without retuning
invalidation: family/source identity mismatch or unavailable official source
family overlap with any previously consumed or pre-registered cycle
score access before annotation and query review are sealed
threshold, metric, comparator, split, or query mutation after this plan merges
agent audit represented as independent human review
publication_policy: automated catalog publication remains disabled unless this exact held-out gate passes, an independently reviewed calibrated EGVV contract is emitted, and the deterministic publication contract passes
